  • Step 2- Plan where you want to install and cut the size accordingly to better fit the wall.

  • If you want to remove the tile, use a heat gun or a blow dryer to warm up the glue and pull softly starting with the corners, that won't damage the wall.

  • In long-lasting usage, we recommend keeping 12 inches or 30 cm away from the center of the stove and fireplace.

  • We do not recommend installing our 3D Wall Decor Tiles in your shower since they will be in direct contact with water.

products.title: 7 Day Mood Mindfulness Tracker
products.body_html:
Start your journey to emotional awareness and mental wellness today.

The 7-Day Mood & Mindfulness Tracker is a compassionate, practical tool designed to help you understand the connection between your daily habits, your mental state, and your practice of mindfulness. This instant digital download provides a structured, beautiful template for tracking your inner life over a focused week.

Why Track Your Mood & Mindfulness?

  • Identify Emotional Triggers: Stop reacting and start understanding. By consistently logging your mood alongside activities and stressors, you can clearly see what causes your emotional shifts.
  • Encourage Consistency: The simple, one-page format motivates you to complete your daily check-in, building a strong habit of self-reflection in just seven days.
  • Measure Self-Care: Track your progress with key wellness indicators like meditation time and gratitude, proving to yourself that your mental health efforts are making a difference.

What You Will Track Daily:

This easy-to-use, printable PDF is your personal guide to deeper self-awareness:

  • Mood Score/Rating: A quick, daily way to quantify your overall emotional state.
  • Emotions Log: Space to name specific feelings (e.g., Anxious, Calm, Joyful) and their intensity.
  • Mindfulness Check: Log your meditation minutes, breathing exercises, or other calming practices.
  • Gratitude Practice: Dedicated space to record what you are thankful for, shifting your focus toward the positive.
  • Notes & Triggers: Critical space to briefly journal about the day's biggest stressors or key events that impacted your mood.

Take the first step toward greater emotional clarity. Download the 7-Day Mood & Mindfulness Tracker now!

featured_image.alt: 7 Day Mood Mindfulness Tracker

products.title: 7 Day Health & Medication Tracker
products.body_html:
Simplify your healthcare routine. Stay compliant, organized, and informed with our essential 7-Day Health & Medication Tracker.

This instant digital download is a clean, easy-to-use template perfect for tracking medications, logging daily health vitals, and monitoring symptoms. It's an indispensable tool for patients managing chronic conditions, seniors, and caregivers.

Why This Tracker is Essential:

  • Ensure Medication Compliance: Clearly log every pill, dosage, and time to eliminate confusion and ensure you or a loved one takes the correct medicine exactly when prescribed.
  • Improve Doctor Communication: Stop struggling to remember details during appointments. You'll have a full, detailed log of symptoms, pain, and vitals to share with your healthcare provider.
  • Identify Trends: The week-long format allows you to quickly see patterns in your symptoms, pain levels, and how your body reacts to medication or changes in routine.

Key Features of the Tracker:

 

This printable tracker provides a clear, day-by-day record of all critical health information:

  • Medication Log: Space to list the Pill Name, Dosage, Time, and a simple check-off column to confirm the dose was taken.
  • Daily Health Vitals: Dedicated sections to record Blood Pressure (BP), Pulse/Heart Rate, and Blood Sugar/Glucose readings.
  • Symptom & Pain Log: Track any new or ongoing symptoms, including a Pain Level Scale (1-10) and a notes section for qualitative details.
  • Hydration & Energy Check: Simple visual trackers for Water Intake and Energy Level to monitor overall wellness.
  • Printable PDF: Download instantly and print as many weekly copies as you need, or use it digitally on your tablet's notetaking app (Goodnotes, etc.).

Take control of your health journey with organization and peace of mind. Download your 7-Day Health & Medication Tracker now.

Candle Storage
Keep candles in cool, dark, and dry places. Excessive temperatures or direct sunlight can cause the surface of the candle to melt, which can affect the degree of aroma of the candle, resulting in insufficient aroma when lit.
Light a Candle
1. Trim the candle wick 3-5mm before lighting it (or not trimming it for the first time)."
2.When burning a candle for the first time, keep burning for more than 2-4 hours. Candles have a "burning memory" if lit for the first time.The wax around the wick is not uniformly heated and the surface melts completely, so the candle burns only around the wick.
Increase Combustion Time
1. Always be careful to keep the wick length 1-1.5 cm. Trim the wick to help the candle burn evenly and prevent black smoke from burning and soot from the bamboo cup.
2. Make sure that the candle is not burned in the ventilated area. The wind will cause the candle to burn unevenly to reduce its life.
3. Try to keep the candle burning for more than two hours at a time, but don't burn more than two hours at a time To burn for a long time, extinguish and trim candles every 4 hours
The core length is about 1cm and can be ignited again.
Extinguish a Candle
1. Always remember not to blow out the candle with your mouth!And don't cover fire-fighting shoots! This will not only damage the candle, but also produce black smoke, which will make the neon candle beautiful
The aroma changed to a smokey smell.
2. The candle wick can be extinguished by dipping it in wax with a candle extinguishing hook tool, or by extinguishing the candle by placing the candle extinguishing.
3. If the candle is less than 1cm, stop burning.
